purpose: Compact projection of existing findings/census and retained export-capture provider metadata. No native source JSONL files or live session stores were opened. No new scan, export or production fix.

fullEvidence.inventoryProvenance: Every full inventory entry in census.json includes per-source counts and up to three concrete source/line or final-state examples. This projection aggregates those entries.
fullEvidence.commandsAndLogs: findings.json#/selectedSamples contains exact export/verification commands, environment overrides, durations and stdout/stderr paths.

sampling.strategy: Stratified purposeful sample, not a random sample. One source per session ID. Large streams capped at 60 MB in selection.
sampling.sourceMtimeMeaning: Filesystem observation, not asserted session creation dates.
sampling.discoveryCorrection: Initial metadata discovery found 115 chatSessions journals. Adding emptyWindowChatSessions added two files: one stable and one Insiders. Final count is 117 journals, not a source-data change.
sampling.activeSessionProtection: Sources modified at/after task start were excluded before selection. No active parent source was read.

limitations: Purposeful sample, not exhaustive or statistically representative.
The largest SDK sources above 60 MB were not sampled.
One small Insiders journal was discovered as metadata but was not sampled.
No remote, WSL, cloud or arbitrary custom user-data root survey.
Includes older/smaller sessions and one empty Local placeholder.
Per-file captures are reproducible, not an atomic multi-store snapshot.

versions.caveat: Installed editor/extension versions describe this machine now, not the versions that produced historical Local records. SDK headers record producer/version where available.

criticalCaveats.action: Kept failed Markdown, diagnostic log, companions and capture. No retry or repair.

criticalCaveats.caveat: Exports and captures are private. Text redaction is best-effort and does not inspect image pixels. Passing content checks does not prove complete semantic fidelity.

catalogues.countMeaning: Occurrence counts are aggregate inventory occurrences within the named scope. Raw mutations/events can repeat logical content. Final Local positions and actual tool identities have separate units.
catalogues.normalization: Array indices and numeric keys become []. UUID/hash/call-ID map keys become {id}; absolute path/URI map keys become {path}. No primitive text values are stored except short discriminator, tool-name, state and version labels.

fieldPathTypes.selectionRule: Budget-limited catalogue, prioritizing shallower fields, final Local/event records, actual tool arguments, content/results/attachments and errors. No per-session copies or raw occurrences.

projectionBudget.policy: Keep every kind, event type, tool name and discriminator entry. Trim only the optional field-path/type sampler to fit. Full evidence files remain unchanged.
